IC1: - Pathologically confirmed intermediate- [OR] or high-risk prostate cancer
IC2: - Biochemical recurrence after radical prostatectomy (Definition: Serial elevation of PSA over 0.2 ng/mL [AND] and <=1.0 ng/mL)
IC4: - Appropriate values of blood tests within 6 months after enrollment Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) ≥ 1500 cells/mm3 Platelets ≥ 50,000 cells/mm3 Hemoglobin ≥ 8.0 g/dl
IC5: - Appropriate values of kidney function within 6 months after enrollment Creatinine < 2.0 ng/dL
IC6: - Appropriate values of liver function within 6 months after enrollment total bilirubin < 1.5 X maximum normal value alanine aminotransferase [OR] or aspartate aminotransferase < 2.5 X maximum normal value
